dig.description: The Dig crates (public/dig.json): records new, back in stock or cheaper in the last `days` days, at most `perCrate` each; a price drop counts from `dropMin` to `dropMax` (share of the old price; bigger drops are pricing errors).

quality.description: Data-quality checks of npm run index (scripts/quality): a record priced under `minEur` or over `maxEur` (converted to euros with data/rates.json) has its price removed; a shop with at least `shopMinRecords` priced records whose median price is under `shopMinMedianEur` or over `shopMaxMedianEur` has all its prices removed (wrong currency); titles matching `testTitle` (shop test listings) are left out. `samples`: examples per reason in generated/quality-report.json.

health.description: Daily health report (scripts/health, run by Deploy): today's build against the last build of an earlier day. Degraded when records drop by more than `recordsDropMax` (share) or searchable shops by more than `shopsDropMax`, the site exceeds `siteMaxMB`, more than `crawlErrorMax` of the crawled shops failed, the crawl is older than `crawlMaxAgeHours`, or an end-to-end test failed. One GitHub issue labelled `label` is opened or updated, and closed once healthy. `keepDays` days of numbers are kept in the data release (health.json).
health.label: health

enrich.description: Artist profiles from open sources (scripts/enrich, docs/sources.md), run daily by the Enrich workflow. Each run reads the artists of the live site (/api/artists.json) and profiles at most `artistsPerRun` of them, for at most `maxMinutes`: new ones first, then the oldest after `refreshDays` (`retryNoneDays` for one not found). An artist is matched on MusicBrainz only through one of its records in stock (`titlesPerArtist` titles tried), never by name alone. Requests are one at a time per host, at least `paceMs` apart (MusicBrainz asks for one a second). Wikipedia summaries in `wikipediaLanguages`; `genres`: most-voted MusicBrainz genres kept; `imageWidth`: Wikimedia Commons thumbnail width. `leadChars`: the summary's first sentences shown up to this length, the rest under "Read more". `paceMs` also paces the social job (scripts/social): the relay, plc.directory and the Bluesky app view; any other host (a collector's account server) gets one request a second.

social.description: The collectors feed (scripts/social, docs/feed.md), run daily by Refresh: accounts that published a list (com.lpepfinder.list, opt-in) found through the Bluesky `relay` (listReposByCollection), at most `maxCollectors`; each one's lists read from its own account. Out comes public/social.json: the collectors, how many want and have each record, the records wanted since the day before (kept `eventDays` days, at most `maxEvents`) and the `topWanted` most wanted.

check.description: How often shops are checked (scripts/check/plan.js): a full check (home page, robots.txt, platform probe, Bluesky) every `fullDays` days, the day after a failed crawl and when a shop's address changes; robots.txt alone on the days between, so an opt-out counts the next day. Dead shops are checked again after half the days they've been dead, at most every `deadMaxDays`.
